About

Good writing, on time and ready to use.

Give me a brief, and you'll get writing back that's clean, considered, and ready to use. Not a rough draft you have to fix up, but a finished piece you can publish as is. My job is to make it easy for you to take an idea and put it in front of the people who need to see it.

Most of my work sits across three areas: blog and article writing, website copy, and screenwriting. But I like being useful wherever words are needed, so if what you've got in mind falls outside that, I'm probably still interested.

"Give me the idea. I'll hand back the finished piece."
